fixed.explanation: The serializer treats Map and Set as plain objects with no own keys, so they come out as empty objects. I added opt-in Map/Set encoding ('m' and 's' keys) to innerSerialize, enabled through a new option on serializeAsCallArgument that only storageScript passes. parseEvaluationResultValue now rebuilds Map and Set values, so the IndexedDB round trip keeps their contents.
